description: Arknights Gacha Record Analyzer for Yostar servers (EN, JP, KR), supporting record import, export, statistics, and charts.
news_content: 🌐 This site supports Yostar's EN, JP, and KR servers. Click here for TW Server or CN Server (External).
news_content_2: ✨ Android users can install our Exclusive APP, and PC users can install the Browser Extension for one-click record extraction.
instructions_1:
Method 2 is for querying records already stored on this site. If you don't have any, you need to fetch or upload them first. Here are the instructions for Method 1 (Web Fetch): (Browser DevTools required)
Please login to JP Official Site, EN Official Site or KR Official Site, use F12 DevTools, then under "Application" -> "Cookie", find the values of "YSSID" and "YSSID.sig" and fill them in.
instructions_2: This website will NOT keep your cookies. It's only used as a temporary credential to fetch gacha records from official servers. The credential is destroyed immediately after use and never stored persistently. To avoid any risks, we recommend logging out of the official website after fetching.
about_desc: This site is a custom-built gacha record export, analysis and visual statistics tool for Arknights players on Yostar's EN, JP and KR servers. You can fetch your gacha history from the official site or import your past records, with end-to-end support for importing, fetching, merging, caching and exporting backups of your data.
about_features:
Main features include:
• Statistical Analysis: Automatically calculates the accumulated pity count for each pool category (Standard, Kernel, Limited) and the average 6-star rate, with colourful distribution charts.
• Data Management: Once fetched, your records can be imported, exported, backed up, overwritten or cleared at any time in JSON format, keeping your data safe.
• Cross-Platform Support: Update and view your data easily through several sign-in methods — website, browser extension, app, JSON import, or UID lookup.
warning_1: 1: This site does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of any data. Records here may be cleared at any time without prior notice, so please export and back up your records regularly. If you need to delete your records, use "Method 3: JSON" to upload a blank file.
warning_2: 2: Note that due to Method 2, anyone can access your records here using your UID. Delete your records timely if concerned.
warning_3: 3: Note that due to Method 3, anyone can overwrite your records here using your UID. Please export timely.
warning_4: 4: To merge past records during a fetch, first use "Method 3: JSON" to upload your previous visit_logs.json, log out, then fetch again with any method. "Method 2: UID" can also be used to check whether your past records still exist and are complete.

privacy_title: Privacy Policy - Arknights Global Gacha Analyzer
privacy_intro_1: Arknights Global Gacha Analyze is a fully open-source web tool, together with a companion Chromium extension, designed to help players export and analyze their in-game headhunting (gacha) records.
privacy_intro_2: This privacy policy explains how we handle your data.
privacy_data_1: In order to provide the export service, and only when you explicitly instruct it to, this tool reads the following specific Authentication Information from your browser, either automatically or manually:
privacy_data_2: Your login Cookie (the Cookie used to confirm your login status)
privacy_use_1_title: Single Purpose: This authentication information is used solely and exclusively to send compliant API requests to Yostar's official servers in order to download your headhunting records, and is destroyed immediately once that is complete.
privacy_use_2_title: No Third-Party Sharing: We will never share this information with any third-party service, advertiser, or data broker.
privacy_use_3_title: No Other Uses: Your credentials will never be used to perform any unauthorized operation other than fetching your gacha records.
privacy_transfer_1: Because the official API is designed with security restrictions in mind (CORS), the extension must send the authentication information it obtains over encrypted HTTPS to our Firebase server, which performs the proxied request and processing.
privacy_transfer_2_title: Secure Transfer: All communications are HTTPS/TLS encrypted.
privacy_transfer_3_title: No Persistent Storage of Tokens: Once our server has retrieved your records, it caches your Gacha Records — temporarily or after conversion — in our Firebase cloud database (indexed anonymously by your in-game UID alone) so that the statistics and chart features can be provided. However, your login status on the Gryphline site, your authentication Cookie and your Token are never persistently stored in our database, and are destroyed immediately once that request has been processed.
privacy_ext_1: Our Chromium extension requires the following permissions in order to operate properly and securely:
privacy_ext_2: cookies: To read the authentication Cookie on the Yostar login page you are currently signed in to.
privacy_ext_3: scripting: To run a very small, local script within the official page environment in order to extract the X-Role-Token stored in localStorage.
privacy_ext_4: activeTab: Ensures the extension is only triggered while you are on the official page and actively click the button.
privacy_ext_5: storage: To temporarily store settings or the extracted credentials on your local machine, so they can be passed to our analysis page.
privacy_rights_1: Using this tool means you consent to short-term processing of auth info.
privacy_rights_2: If you wish to stop using the service and revoke your consent, you only need to:
privacy_rights_3: Click the "Logout" button on the site to clear your local login status.
privacy_rights_5: (Optional) Go to the Yostar official site and log out, to invalidate the credentials you submitted.
privacy_contact_1: If you have any questions, suggestions, or concerns regarding data privacy, please feel free to open an issue on the website's GitHub repository, extension's GitHub repository or APP's GitHub repository, and we will respond to you as soon as possible.
